claims.text: The beaches of Psarou, Paranga and Agia Anna and the Scorpios promontory are a short stroll from the hotel's beach.

findings.quote: A short stroll away, the beaches of glamorous Psarou, Paranga, and Agia Anna await, along with the iconic promontory where ultra-cool Scorpios holds court.

claims.text: Glass-bottom boat rides and private yacht charters depart from the hotel's jetty.

findings.quote: Glass-bottom boat rides and private yacht charters depart from our jetty

claims.text: The Emblematic Suite sits at the highest point of the hillside, with a veranda and a marble pool with expansive views.

findings.quote: Nestled at the highest point of the hillside, this 35m² retreat offers a 20m² veranda and a 40m² marble pool with expansive views.

claims.text: Signature Suites have a broad terrace with a private Jacuzzi, a freestanding bath and a rain shower.

findings.quote: Relax on the broad terrace with a private Jacuzzi or enjoy the Aegean views from your plush bed. Includes a freestanding bath, rain shower, and seating area.

claims.text: The Villa has eight bedrooms, a landscaped garden and a terrace with a pool and Jacuzzi.

findings.quote: An eight-bedroom Myconian paradise blending island charm with modern luxury. Panoramic views, hardwood floors and a landscaped garden
Terrace highlights include a pool, Jacuzzi, and views, views, views!

claims.text: Classic rooms have marble floors, warm wood accents, all-white tones with classic blue, and designer lighting.

findings.quote: Marble floors, crisp linens, and warm wood accents complement all-white tones and classic blue. Designer lighting creates a serene ambiance

claims.text: Spa therapists work with Elemis, St. Barth and Augustinus Bader products.

findings.quote: Our therapists work with three award-winning ranges: Elemis, the leading British spa and skincare brand
St. Barth, a coveted Caribbean line prized for its all-natural floral blends; and Augustinus Bader

claims.text: The gym includes a Pilates Reformer, with private Pilates and yoga sessions available.

findings.quote: Our fitness gym features the latest in exercise systems, including a Pilates Reformer. Private sessions are available for both Pilates and yoga.

claims.text: The pool deck has sweeping Aegean views.

findings.quote: The pool deck feels like a world of its own, with sweeping Aegean views

claims.text: Yacht charters from the hotel's launch at Platis Gialos can visit Delos for a private guided tour, then swimming and snorkelling in Rhenia's waters.

findings.quote: Book a yacht charter from our launch at Platis Gialos for an unforgettable day at sea.
or visit ancient Delos, the mythological birthplace of Apollo
Take a private guided tour before swimming and snorkelling in Rhenia’s pristine waters.

claims.text: Helicopter rides fly over Mykonos, Delos and Rhenia toward Tinos, Paros and Naxos.

findings.quote: Fly over Mykonos, its sunbaked landscape dotted with whitewashed houses, then sweep across Delos and Rhenia before heading towards Tinos, Paros, and Naxos

claims.text: Efisia restaurant is set in a stone alcove with sea views.

findings.quote: Nestled in a stone alcove with sea views, Efisia is a culinary destination

claims.text: The hotel is set directly above Platis Gialos beach.

findings.quote: Our hotel is situated directly above this beach

claims.text: The Grand Suite sits atop a hill with a veranda and an all-marble pool with breathtaking views.

findings.quote: Perched atop a hill, this 35m² retreat features a 20m² veranda and a 40m² all-marble pool with breathtaking views.

claims.text: The Thalasso Spa has steam rooms and Thalasso pools with varying temperatures and salinity.

findings.quote: Steam rooms, Thalasso pools with varying temperatures and salinity, exclusive products, and expert therapists await.

claims.text: Premium rooms come with a balcony or terrace with seating, a private Jacuzzi or a private pool.

findings.quote: Options include a balcony/terrace with seating, private Jacuzzi, or private pool.

claims.text: Yoga sessions include sunrise or full moon yoga and sunset sessions paired with meditation.

findings.quote: secret sunrise or full moon yoga, and sunset sessions paired with meditation

claims.text: Platis Gialos Bay is about five kilometres (three miles) from Mykonos Town.

findings.quote: Platis Gialos Bay is just five kilometres (three miles) from Mykonos Town

claims.text: The beach below the hotel has boutiques and restaurants along its boardwalk.

findings.quote: The beach below our hotel is beloved for its fine sand, crystal-clear waters, and charming boutiques and restaurants along the boardwalk.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes high-end pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
